items: 【Newest Android 14 Tablet 】10 inch Tablet is equipped with the latest Android 14 system, which has been upgraded in all aspects of system operation, with faster response time and more focus on user privacy and security. It also adds a lot of interesting and convenient operations, which greatly improves the user's operating experience.

【2 in 1 Tablet with Keyboard】Android 14 Tablet comes with keyboard, mouse, stylus and foldable protective case, in order to give you work, life and entertainment, you can switch directly between laptop and tablet at any time.

【8GB RAM+64GB ROM+1024GB Expansion】The Android tablet comes with 8GB (2GB+6GB)of RAM for smooth multitasking and efficient performance. It also has 64GB of ROM storage for apps, files, and media.The micro SD card slot offers up to 1024GB of expandable memory, giving you unlimited options (card not included).

【10.1 inch HD Touch Screen】Capture all of life's best moments with the tablet's high-resolution dual cameras. The 2-megapixel front and 8-megapixel rear cameras enable ultra-smooth video chats as well as stunning photos and videos.The 10 inch tablet features a 10.1 inch HD IPS display with a screen resolution of 1280x800 and vibrant, bright colors for a more lifelike visual experience.

【Long-Lasting Battery+Entertainment】10.1 inch tablet is powered by a large 6000mAh battery with low-power consumption quad-core 2.0GHz CPU, allowing you to enjoy 8-10 hours of gaming in mixed use such as reading, watching TV shows, movies, surfing the web, listening to music, shopping, playing games, and more.
